# Evercraft Website Launch Service

Evercraft public capability ID: website-launch-service-v1
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: payment_ready
Public handoff: https://instant-website-builder-usa-6feac193.base44.app/functions/websiteServiceAgentGateway?view=docs

## Use this when

- build me a business website
- launch a website for my company
- replace my bad website
- make me a professional business site
- handle my website for me

## Problem

A business needs a professional website built or upgraded without operating a site-builder interface.

## Inputs

Choose one verified service tier and provide customer name/email, business name and a useful project brief. Current website and phone are optional.

## Outputs

A bounded paid website-service order and completed website/service outcome through the existing fulfillment workflow.

## Commercial truth

- Pricing: Human-Finished Pro Site $500 one-time; Premium Custom Build $999 one-time; Total Business Launch $1,999 one-time.
- Human UI required: no
- Confirmation: The buyer must explicitly choose a tier and confirm payment before checkout. Fulfillment begins only after independent payment verification.
- Payment authority: Evercraft Website Service / Stripe, provider-verified

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Do not invent availability, pricing, authority, endorsement, or payment state.
